credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe walking alone in the canyon with a shaft of light running by her feet. He wears a white headscarf and a matching jacket and skirt.This photograph is part of the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Standing in Light Next to Pool of Water
